description: Answers a yes-or-no question with the tarot, by the app's rule: major arcana are turned over one by one until a card decides (Judgement says yes, The Hanged Man says no, The Fool asks to rephrase the question). Returns the answer, the deciding card with its reading, and the cards turned before it, which tell why. It returns the app's text for each card, not a synthesis: reading the draw as a whole for the person's question (each card in its position, the cards together) is left to the assistant, from these texts only.

deck.description: majors: the 22 major arcana (default); full: all 78 cards.

language.description: Language of the readings: en, fr, es, pt-BR, ja or de (default en). Use the language of the conversation.

question.description: The person's question, in her words, if she asked one (never stored).

name: tarot_yes_no
title: Tarot yes or no
